model.title: Small County PILT Parity Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Steve Daines (R-MT)

summary.text: The bill would expand federal payments to smaller counties under the Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILT) program by creating new population categories, aiming to direct more federal funding to counties with lower populations that have significant federal lands within their borders.
